narrative.markdown:
**At a glance** — 선크림: currently **Declining** (phase certainty: high); over the next 26 weeks the level is expected to change by **−67.1%** (downward). Chance of rise 1%, forecast reliability medium.

## Past: how it got here
- Analysed 260 weekly observations from Nov 29, 2021 to Nov 22, 2026 (about 5 years).
- On the trend line the level fell from 48.1 to 0.
- The Mann-Kendall test finds a statistically significant **downward** trend. The long-run slope is −0.26/wk (−0.85%/wk of the mean level).
- The peak was 90.5 on Aug 1, 2022; the latest value (0.66) is 99.3% below it — less than a tenth of the peak.
- No structural breaks were detected — the trend has followed a fairly consistent path.
- 3 statistical anomalies detected:
  - Apr 29, 2024: actual 22.8 vs. expected 28.5 (−19.9%, z = −7.0) — an unusual dip
  - Sep 30, 2024: actual 40.8 vs. expected 37.3 (+9.5%, z = +3.9) — an unusual spike
  - Dec 30, 2024: actual 16.4 vs. expected 9.64 (+70.1%, z = +4.3) — an unusual spike
- Seasonality is very strong (strength 0.91), typically highest in August and lowest in February; trend consistency is very high (trend strength 0.97).

## Present: where it stands now
- Current lifecycle phase: **Declining** (phase certainty: high).
- Evidence: The trend has fallen to 0 since its peak (Aug 8, 2022, 66.7).
- Evidence: Over the last 39 weeks the trend fell from 16.4 to 0.
- Evidence: The Mann-Kendall test finds a significant downward trend over the whole period.
- Over the last 52 weeks the trend fell from 13.6 to 0.
- Momentum (recent minus long-run slope) is not given in pp because the trend has fallen to about 0: falling faster than its long-run pace.
- Volatility is 12.7% — moderate.
- Latest value: 0.66 (Nov 16, 2026); average over the last 52 weeks: 3.45.

## Outlook
- The seasonally adjusted average forecast over the next 26 weeks is expected to change by **−67.1%** from the average of the last 52 weeks (**downward**; forecast to May 17, 2027). A 26-week window covers only part of the 52-week seasonal cycle, so its typical seasonal effect is removed before comparing.
- Probability that the seasonally adjusted average forecast over the next 26 weeks is higher than the average of the last 52 weeks: about **1%** — a fall is very likely.
- Scenarios for May 17, 2027 (80% interval; % vs. the actual value at the same point of the season, May 18, 2026: 4.47): pessimistic 0 (floor) · base 1.15 (−74.3%) · optimistic 2.31 (−48.5%); 95% interval 0 (floor) – 3.05. The interval is wide enough that the pessimistic case reaches the floor of 0 (values cannot go below 0). These end-point values include the seasonal swing at that date, so they can differ from the average-based change and probability above.
- No distinct forecast peak (rise, then fall) within the horizon.
- Projected phase at the horizon: still **Declining**.
- Forecast reliability: **medium**.
- Accuracy: in backtests on past data the error was **about 73%** lower than that of the best simple benchmark (repeat the last value, repeat the last season, or extend the straight line).
- Method: an ensemble of 3 models (Holt-Winters seasonal (log scale) 36% · damped-trend Holt (log scale) 34% · Holt linear trend 31%) — weighted by backtest accuracy.
